guides.favoredWhen: Skill matchup, slightly hers. Time E on her E-down and trade only E-ready.

keyTips.text: Skill matchup, she is slightly favoured once learned: respect reps.
She trades hard while your E is down: never fight E-less.
Your R reveals her: mark before she shrouds.

tips.text: She times her E around your Q+W: vary the combo.
She punishes pre-spike levels: survive to your all-in.
E-down is her engage: track it like a summoner.
Force her E first: no dash means free Qs.
E held plus R landed: the Akali who never reaches you never wins.

sources.author: Anguish333
sources.rankClaim: Master (profile badge; title claims 2000LP GrandMaster EUW and Challenger EUNE) · Akali main

guides.favoredWhen: Fizz-favoured. She baits E and Charms your Q, so E her damage, trade into Plating, and outscale.

keyTips.text: Fizz-favoured: she must answer your E, not the reverse.
She baits E by fake-stepping in: do not E the feint.
Her main cooldown to track is your E (about {cd:105:E}): spend it only to dodge or kill.

tips.text: She bullies levels 1-2, then lets the wave back: concede the first waves.
Dodge her fox-fire W with E and trade her mana into your Bone Plating.
If you commit an obvious Q she Charms mid-dash: Q only when her Charm is down.
She pushes by default: match the shove and outscale.
E held plus Charm dodged: the Ahri who never catches you never wins.

guides.favoredWhen: She bullies 1-2 and bans push-ups from 3. Crash pre-3, then dive with E.

keyTips.text: You are punishable at 1-2 and she is strong at 3 and 6: the lane flips on spikes.
Take Bone Plating: it blunts her combo.
Her E is trade tool and waveclear in one: bait it before diving.

tips.text: Deny her crash: meet the wave before it breaks.
Respect 3 and 6: her spikes are your stop signs.
Dive with E when her E is down: troll pole beats scatter.
She takes Barrier, Exhaust or early Null-Magic: expect the defensive setup.
Spikes survived plus E dives: the Syndra who never zones you never wins.

sources.author: Trisend3
sources.rankClaim: Challenger (title and profile badge) · Syndra main

guides.favoredWhen: He answers your Q with backwards combos. Trade with Plating up, and dive only when his W is down.

keyTips.text: He takes Bone Plating and answers your Q-in with double-W backwards: respect the answer.
Trade only with your Plating up: no Plating means no trade.
Your E is the trade tool and the dive: spend it to kill, not to poke.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: Poke, do not commit: his backwards combo punishes engages.
Q in only when his W is spent: shadow-down is your window.
Dive with E when his answers are down: troll pole beats shadows.
Keep trading with Plating: the pattern never changes.
Death Mark lands him behind you: E away from the exit when he ults.
Plating traded plus dives timed: the Zed who never catches you never wins.

keyTips.text: Start E in most lanes and refuse trades until level 3, treating level-2 trades as matchup-only.
Guard E as both damage and the main dodge or escape; casual casts delete all pressure until it returns.
Throw max-range R for the biggest shark with stronger damage, slow, and teamfight disruption even without a kill.

tips.text: Donate some of the first two waves against heavy poke to keep health for later trades.
At level 1, last-hit melee minions with E while sparing the caster line, then let the opponent push in.
Take W at level 2 and take only safe last-hits instead of eating free autos.
When wave two crashes under tower, expect wave three back toward center with a chance at first level 3.
Trade at level 3 with Q onto the enemy, auto plus W, keep hitting until they answer, then E away to dodge and slow.
After a good level-3 trade, shove fast for level 4 and crash the wave.
At level 4, check kill range before all-inning with Flash, Q, W, and Ignite.
For that level-4 commit, take a second W point over a second E point, then return to maxing E.
On level-4 dives, drop turret aggro with E instead of spending it purely for damage.
Buy Dark Seal early, upgrading to Mejai's only past 10 stacks and when the stacks project to survive.
Keep Zhonya's Hourglass second for safer engages, dives, and side duels.
Q to a minion after E to finish the wave or land in a safer trade spot.
Land R on a backline carry to decide fights, accepting the hard execution cost.
Hide the cast and stretch its reach with Q through a minion into an immediate R.
Q onto a minion after E to apply W or exit safely rather than leaning on Q damage alone.

itemization.text: Run Press the Attack with Triumph, Legend: Haste, and Coup de Grace, plus Manaflow Band and Transcendence, with Flash and Ignite.
Recall first for Dark Seal with enough gold, upgrading to Mejai's at 10 stacks only when they project to live.
Hold Zhonya's second and use its active to extend an engage or stall for the next rotation.
Choose Lich Bane for all-in damage and movement speed, or Dusk and Dawn as the preferred teamfight spellblade.
On Dusk and Dawn, trigger W before the first spellblade hit to double its on-hit effect, setting up with W then Q.
Pair Press the Attack with the Dusk and Dawn route.
